title: Government keen to bring foreign university campuses to KWIN City: Minister M.B. Patil
content: KWIN City is being developed across 5,000 acres. Development work on the first phase is currently under way, and the tendering process has been completed, says the Minister.

title: MLAs, MP raise demands at meet on Idukki’s power-related concerns

title: FIFA bans Leandro Paredes for 10 matches over World Cup final scuffle
content: Argentina midfielder Leandro Paredes has been handed a 10-match ban by FIFA following a scuffle with Spain players moments after the World Cup final. Paredes received the longest suspension among three Argentina players punished for the incident. The sanctions were announced by FIFA on Friday.

title: The invisible war: Iran's evolving cyberattacks bring battlefront to small-town America
content: The escalation of Iran's cyber capabilities in its ongoing tensions with the US and Israel is becoming increasingly pronounced. Recent intrusions into US water facilities mark a transition into a new blend of warfare. These digital strikes bolster military initiatives while attempting to sway international public opinion. Additionally, the infusion of artificial intelligence into these operations allows for unprecedented efficiency and breadth, reinforcing Iran's asymmetric strategies within its military doctrine.

title: Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn
content: Meta CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, have acquired the historic Strancally Castle, a stunning Gothic mansion set on an expansive estate in Ireland. This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history.

title: Maharashtra teen jumps off cliff, parents fall to death trying to save him
content: A family of three tragically died after falling into a deep stone quarry on Friday. The incident occurred when parents attempted to save their son from a dangerous cliff edge. Police and fire brigade personnel were present and had been trying to persuade the youth for hours. The son suddenly fell, and his father tried to grab him, losing his own balance.

title: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal gives an update on Temple device
content: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal revealed the Temple wearable device is now smaller and more powerful.  Pre-orders for the limited launch edition will begin very soon.  The device is expected to ship before the end of 2026.  PV Sindhu was recently seen wearing the Temple device at a championship.  This device tracks blood flow and oxygenation inside the brain.

title: Lip plumpers, collagen & more: How Ozempic is boosting a new beauty market
content: Weight-loss drugs are creating new demands in beauty and nutrition sectors. Companies are developing products to address nutritional gaps and emerging beauty concerns. Nestle and Tata Consumer are preparing protein and fiber-rich offerings for these consumers. Beauty brands are promoting makeup alternatives to cosmetic procedures for users. This trend is driven by pharmaceutical advancements and growing patient bases.

title: Family sold 53,000-acre California island for $30m, stayed 25 more years
content: In 1986, the United States government acquired Santa Rosa Island for close to thirty million dollars. This pivotal purchase marked the end of longstanding private ranching and agricultural practices on the sprawling island. Following the removal of cattle in 1998 and the cessation of residency in 2011, efforts towards environmental restoration commenced. Today, the island stands as a protected national sanctuary and an important cultural landmark.

title: US seized California island ranch after $4m offer; jury awarded family $12.7m
content: A federal jury awarded a California family $12.7 million for their Santa Cruz Island ranch.  The government had seized the 6,300-acre property using eminent domain in 1996.  This verdict concluded a decades-long property dispute between park officials and the Gherini family.  The family's ancestors had owned part of the island since the late 19th century.  The award allowed the National Park Service to gain full control of the land.

title: Govt orders Google to shut down hundreds of Firebase accounts over scam misuse
content: Indian authorities ordered Google to close hundreds of Firebase accounts.  These accounts were exploited by criminals for banking scams and malware.  Officials found a pattern of impersonating major banks to defraud users.  The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued multiple notices for account removals.  This action is part of India's increased efforts against online financial fraud.

title: Who pays what in a rental home? Property tax, maintenance and utility bills explained
content: In India, property taxes are fundamentally the responsibility of the property owner as per municipal regulations. Meanwhile, utility expenses for water and electricity are usually settled by the tenant who consumes these services. Maintenance fees of housing societies are generally charged to owners, but tenancy agreements can sometimes allocate part of these costs to renters. Clarifying these responsibilities helps avoid conflicts between landlords and tenants.

title: 'Being Pullela Gopichand's daughter is a big baggage': Coach B Sumeeth Reddy
content: Player-turned-coach Sumeeth Reddy says Gayatri Gopichand's maiden World Championships medal is more than a podium finish. It's the release of years of expectation carried as the daughter of Indian badminton legend and national coach Pullela Gopichand. The team of Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly defeated China's Jia Yi Fan and Zhang Shu Xian 16-21, 21-15, 21-13 to secure at least a bronze.

title: Mendoza's 'no girlfriend' vow faces test as Alysa Liu dating rumors swirl
content: Following a triumphant win against the Houston Texans, Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza expressed previously that his focus was on football, sidelining romance. However, fans are buzzing about his recent outing with Olympic figure skater Alysa Liu. The duo sparked dating speculation after they enjoyed a video game together and were spotted at the renowned 2026 ESPY Awards ceremony.

title: Bold Habs trade pitch for Crosby reignites debate over his future in Pittsburgh
content: A fresh trade suggestion for Sidney Crosby has the Montreal Canadiens and Pittsburgh Penguins at the center of new NHL trade rumors. Toronto sports host Sid Seixeiro floated a hypothetical trade sending Crosby to Montreal for Michael Hage and a 1st-round pick in 2027. The proposal is not an actual trade report, though. Crosby is still expected to speak on a potential Penguins extension soon.

title: Roman Reigns' net worth edges out Cody Rhodes in 2026 WWE star comparison
content: Through championship reigns, big contracts, merchandise and commercial deals, Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns have become some of WWE’s biggest assets. Reigns is said to have a net worth bigger than Rhodes in 2026, but no official figures are confirmed. Cody Rhodes’ financial picture is also improving thanks to his business background, his rising profile in WWE and his endorsement deals.

title: Supreme Court closes 'The Kerala Story' petitions, says question of law will 'await another movie'
content: The Supreme Court disposed of petitions challenging CBFC's certification of "The Kerala Story," ruling them infructuous since the film had already released, while leaving the broader legal question on certification challenges open. Justice Bagchi said this would "await another movie." The court also declined immediate hate speech guidelines, suggesting a separate comprehensive petition instead.

title: Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ peppy song ‘Ala Bolelo’ out, gets fans grooving
content: The highly anticipated single 'Ala Bolelo' from Jailer 2 has finally dropped. Featuring the legendary Rajinikanth alongside actress Shamna Kasim, the catchy tune boasts an energetic lyrical video. The track is composed and sung by the talented Anirudh Ravichander, with creative lyrics penned by Arunraja Kamaraj. A recent teaser teased an intense moment where Vinayakan warns Rajinikanth's character, setting the stage for the film's release on October 15, 2026.

title: FDA shuts Radio Club, Khar Gymkhana, McDonald's Colaba kitchens over hygiene violations
content: The FDA has temporarily revoked licenses for The Bombay Presidency Radio Club and Khar Gymkhana, citing poor waste management and pest control. The kitchen at The Bombay Presidency Radio Club was notably infested with flies and included dead cockroaches, while a live cockroach issue led to a similar suspension for McDonald's Colaba. These measures highlight serious breaches of hygiene and food safety regulations.

title: Congress’s renewed youth outreach: How CJP has forced parties to course correct
content: Student protests at Jantar Mantar have prompted political parties to rethink their youth engagement strategies. The Congress party is now focusing on youth issues and expanding its outreach programs nationwide. Rahul Gandhi's recent actions highlight the party's renewed commitment to addressing student concerns. The Congress Working Committee has proposed an education-to-employment roadmap for young people. This shift reflects a broader effort to regain support among the nation's youth.

title: India new ‘swing supplier’ for refined oil products. Can it sustain?
content: Oil products now account for a much larger share of India's exports to several destinations. India has about 258.1 million tonnes of installed refining capacity across 23 refineries. It is the fourth-largest refining centre globally after the US, China and Russia.

title: Arjun Rampal marries his girlfriend Gabriella Demetriades in Goa
content: On Friday, Arjun Rampal and Gabriella Demetriades took a significant step in their relationship by registering their marriage in Goa. This took place at the Sub-Registrar's office in Mapusa, where they were granted special permission to skip the usual 15-day waiting period. The couple, who have been together since 2018 and share two sons, celebrated their engagement in a prior podcast episode.

title: Joe Root creates history in Headingly against Pakistan
content: In a remarkable achievement, Joe Root has eclipsed Steve Smith to become the foremost fielder for Test cricket catches. This significant milestone was celebrated with a crisp catch at leg slip during the opening Test. With a strategic bowling effort, England's attack secured Root's record-breaking moment, allowing the team to establish a commanding lead against Pakistan in the match, further embellishing Root's impressive cricket legacy.

title: 1 dead, 3 injured after building collapses during demolition work in Karol Bagh
content: A labourer died and three others were injured when a building collapsed during demolition work. The incident occurred in Delhi's Karol Bagh area on Pyare Lal Road. Preliminary inquiries suggest the building owners lacked necessary demolition permits from authorities. Rescue operations were launched by police and fire services after local residents alerted them. The building owners and the contractor have been detained for questioning regarding the collapse.

title: Pakistan's Ali Usman creates history, ends 16-year wait in England
content: Usman was Pakistan's standout bowler. He finished with 5/95 from 24 overs and claimed his first five-wicket haul in England. The left-arm spinner also became the first visiting left-arm spinner since Shakib Al Hasan in 2010 to take five wickets in a Test innings in England. Usman was also the first visiting spinner to take a five-wicket haul at Leeds since Australia's Ashley Mallett took 5/114 in 1972.

title: Harry and Meghan's California mansion may be sold as couple weighs return to Britain
content: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are contemplating selling their lavish Montecito mansion as the financial burden of over $600,000 annually in mortgage and property taxes weighs heavily. Initially purchased for $14.65 million, the estate is generating buzz among brokers, with potential sale prices estimated between $55 million and $65 million. A final decision may follow their relocation to the UK.

title: 'Programme not appropriate': MEA on no clearance for Telangana CM's US visit
content: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy's planned visit to the US has been denied political clearance by the Ministry of External Affairs, which found the proposed activities unsuitable. However, he has secured clearance for his trip to the UK. As a result, the Chief Minister's office confirmed the cancellation of the US portion, prompting an earlier return to Hyderabad than originally planned.

title: Why short-range ballistic missiles are the new weapon of choice, and how Pralay stands out
content: Modern conflicts highlight the challenge of intercepting short-range ballistic missiles effectively.  Russia and Iran have extensively used such weapons in recent warfare.  India's Pralay missile offers battlefield flexibility and operates outside nuclear doctrine.  This missile features terminal maneuverability and a solid-fuel propulsion system.  Pralay's capabilities position it as a leading short-range ballistic missile globally.

title: BJP claims influencers were offered Rs 25,000 to attend Rahul Gandhi's Pune event
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party has raised allegations against Rahul Gandhi’s forthcoming event in Pune, claiming it relies on paid influencers. Reports suggest these influencers are being compensated with twenty-five thousand rupees to promote and attend the event. A video shared by the party allegedly illustrates this process, suggesting attendees are tasked with creating and posting promotional content, which casts doubt on the genuine nature of support for the Congress leader.

title: BrahMos after Op Sindoor: Why more countries are lining up for India’s supersonic missile
content: India's Brahmos missile proved its combat effectiveness in recent operations.  This success has significantly boosted its appeal as a defense export.  Several nations are now seeking to acquire this advanced supersonic cruise missile.  The Philippines, Vietnam, and Indonesia have already signed deals for the weapon.  Further interest from countries in the Gulf and Southeast Asia is growing.

title: Quote of the day by Johnny Depp
content: During his appearance at Cannes, Johnny Depp delved into the topic of social conformity versus individuality. He shared a poignant quote relating to the challenge many individuals encounter in being authentic. Recognizing that conformity might be a valid path for some, Depp revealed his inclination to transcend conventional norms, highlighting how his past experiences influenced this perspective.

title: H1N1 surge sets alarm bells ringing in Delhi, JP Nadda calls key health meet
content: On Friday, Union Health Minister JP Nadda will conduct a crucial review of the H1N1 situation in Delhi. This meeting is prompted by a notable rise in swine flu cases due to unstable weather conditions. Health officials will evaluate healthcare preparedness and devise containment strategies. The primary objective is to enhance surveillance and ensure hospitals are fully equipped to curb the virus's spread in the city.

title: 'Definitely in scheme of things': India refuse to panic over Kuldeep after poor Galle Test
content: Kuldeep picked up just one wicket in 25 overs across both innings in Galle, while Ravindra Jadeja and Manav Suthar shared 14 wickets between them.

title: Sahil Lochab, Delhi teen whose pellet injury sparked Rahul Gandhi-Delhi Police standoff
content: Rahul Gandhi took a stand by protesting for the filing of an FIR concerning the pellet injuries sustained by Sahil Lochab. The injuries were inflicted during a CJP demonstration held on July 20th. After his complaint went unacknowledged, Sahil called for police intervention. His career aspirations have been severely affected due to the multiple pellet injuries he sustained.

title: Meghalaya-Assam Taxi Operators' Standoff Continues, Tourists Stranded
content: Cab operators from Assam have been blocking the national highway toward Shillong at Jorabat on the Assam-Meghalaya border.

content: Randhir Jaiswal, the official spokesperson of the Ministry of External Affairs, addressed the bi-weekly press briefing in Delhi and said both Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are integral and indivisible parts of India.

title: Delhi Warns Pharmacies Over 'Up To 80% Off' Ads, Says Discounts Must Be Genuine
content: The department, however, made it clear that selling medicines below the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) is permitted. Its objection is to vague or exaggerated advertisements that could mislead customers about the discount actually available.

title: Delhi Police Bust High-Tech Betting Network, 31 Arrested
content: The Anti-Narcotics Squad of Outer North District Police conducted a raid on August 9 after receiving information about a gambling operation being run from a premises in Mukundpur.

content: The police have collected the medical report and other related documents and the FIR has been filed against unknown persons based on the complaint given by the victim, police said.

title: "3 Pellets In Eye, 200 In Body": Rahul Gandhi Protests With Victim, Demands FIR

title: Roach, Flies, Fakes: Action Against Mumbai McDonald's Outlet, Elite Clubs
content: The inspection at the Bombay Presidency Radio Club uncovered active fly infestations in various kitchen areas, a dead cockroach, and open cockroach traps in the utensil-washing zone.

title: Bitcoin Tops $75,000 For First Time In 3 Months, Up By Over $10,000 In 2 Days
content: The sharp rise came after US President Donald Trump urged lawmakers on Wednesday to pass the Clarity Act, a bill to spur cryptocurrency use that has stalled in the Senate.

title: 'Most Intense' In Over A Century: How This Year's El Nino May Impact World
content: It is expected to be the most "intense" El Nino in more than a century, the head of long-range forecasting at the UK's Met Office warned on Friday.

title: Woman Killed, 1 Injured As Minivan Driven By Minor Rams Into Them In Mumbai
content: Relatives of the victims strongly objected to how the case was handled, accusing the police of delaying the registration of the FIR.

title: Sugar Price Hike Linked To Lower Output, Not Ethanol Production: Centre
content: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution said it was "incorrect" to link the price rise to ethanol production.

title: 2 Ships With 22 Indians Hijacked By Armed Pirates Off Yemen, Somalia
content: The official said that six armed pirates were aboard M.T. Sibu and had taken control of the vessel, while eight armed pirates with AK-47-type weapons boarded M/V LUTUF and were operating from two skiffs.

title: Contractor Fined Rs 25 Lakh, Asked To Help Victims Of Mumbai Crane Collapse
content: The incident occurred during demolition work on an incomplete residential building in the Kurla area. The crane fell towards the adjoining area and came into contact with the railway overhead equipment on the Kurla-Trombay section.

title: On Camera, 2 Women Pushed To Ground, Robbed Of Earrings In 15 Seconds
content: Police say the two women were out on their regular walk when the men allegedly surrounded them without warning, giving them almost no chance to react.

title: After Denying Revanth Reddy's US Visit Request, Centre's "Appropriate" Remark
content: The response came after the Telangana chief minister's office announced the cancellation of Reddy's US visit after not getting permission from the MEA

title: Rajasthan Girls' College Principal Apologises After Massive Protest Over "Misbehaviour" With Student
content: College principal, Manoj Kumar Kulhar, came under fire after several videos of protests against him went viral on social media. The students demanded an apology and an assurance that such an incident would not be repeated in the future.

title: Reality Of 'Har Ghar Jal' In Madhya Pradesh: 23 Districts Below 70% Household Tap Water Coverage
content: 23 of Madhya Pradesh's 55 districts have been assessed as having less than 70 per cent coverage of potable tap water: Figures placed on record by Centre in a written reply in the Rajya Sabha.

title: 'To Moon And Mars': Trump Pledges To Launch More Rockets Into Space
content: The United States is competing with China in the race to land astronauts on the Moon before 2030, more than 50 years after humans first walked the lunar surface.

content: he rejected criticism that Tehran had been forced to make concessions . he defended a recent agreement with the u.s., describing the outcome of negotiations as a 'major achievement' he said the deal was “honorable and valuable” and did not amount to surrender .

title: SC scraps SAD chief Badal’s plea to quash 2017 defamation case
content: a bench of justices dismisses Sukhbir Singh Badal's plea against defamation case . the alleged remarks linking religious organisation Akhand Kirtani Jatha (AKJ) with banned terrorist outfit Babbar Khalsa International (BKI) the former minister's remarks damaged his reputation by associating him with the banned organisation .

title: 'No credibility': India slams US religious freedom body over call for RSS sanctions
content: the ministry of external affairs hits back at the united states commission on international religious freedom . the commission says such organisations have no credibility and operate to peddle their own agenda . this comes days after the USCIRF urged the US government to impose sanctions on RSS members .

title: Rahul's dharna, FIR demand, face-off: How drama unfolded over pellet use
content: Rahul Gandhi claimed that police refused to register a complaint over the "police brutality" during the student protest at Jantar Mantar . police allegedly did not provide an I/O number or acknowledgement . the complaint was followed up again on august 17 through email and phone .

title: 'Proportionate response': MEA on bulldozer action outside Pakistan high commission
content: authorities removed structures and queue-management barriers erected outside of the Pakistan High Commission in new Delhi . the ministry of external affairs said the removal was a "proportionate action in response" to the removal of structures in front of the Indian High Commission .

title: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir sworn in as Bangladesh's 23rd President
content: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was sworn in as the country's 23rd president on friday . the 78-year-old veteran politician and longtime secretary general of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) took the oath at a ceremony attended by prime minister Tarique Rahman, opposition leader Shafiqur Rahman and former Chief Adviser Muhammad Yunus .

title: Crowd-funded anti-bribery portal shuts after amassing 2 lakh users in 48 hrs
content: bribes.fyi clocked 5 million requests and 2 lakh new users within 48 hours . built by 20-year-old student Aryan Nishad, it displayed a neon-red map of india . the site stressed user submissions, not verified cases, then abruptly went offline .

title: 'FIR only after Shah's OK': Rahul on case lodged over protester's pellet injury
content: opposition leader says the FIR registered over student protester's alleged pellet-gun injury is the 'first step towards justice' the case has been registered . it has been a month since he was hit by that bullet .

title: Two tankers with 22 Indians on board hijacked by pirates off Yemen, Somalia
content: two commercial vessels carrying 22 Indian crew members have been hijacked by armed pirates in separate incidents off Yemen and Somalia this week . the sailors reported safe so far, according to a senior shipping ministry official . both vessels remain under pirate control, while no injuries have been reported .
